summary: New bilateral perihilar/basal haze with increased left basilar pleural veiling is present on the current image.

findings.rationale: The prior lungs were largely clear aside from minimal left basilar opacity, while the current image shows new bilateral perihilar and lower-lung hazy opacity after matching the hila and diaphragms, favoring new pulmonary edema over technical change alone.
The left pleural base is much more densely veiled and retrocardiac on the current image than on the prior, indicating increased left pleural fluid.
